cards.real: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

notes: M21 G2 spec: Vito. '{3}{B}{B}: Creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn' affects the creatures you control when it resolves (CR 611.2c): a creature entering afterwards does not gain it, and the opponent's creature never does. The lifelinked 2/2 deals 2 combat damage (you gain 2), and 'Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life' drains 2 more: you 22, opponent 20-2-2 = 16.
